user.title: Add pellet storage
user.description: Each storage (silo, bunker, bag store) gets its own entry. You can add as many as you like.

data.name: Name
data.source_type: Where does the consumption come from?

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Pellet silo".
data_description.source_type: Pick what your heating already reports in Home Assistant. You can change it later.

source_kg_counter.title: Consumption from a kg sensor
source_kg_counter.description: Choose a sensor that counts used pellets in kg. A total counter and a daily counter that resets at midnight both work.

data_description.source_entity: E.g. the daily consumption of your boiler integration.
data_description.calorific_value: Energy in one kg of pellets. 4.8 kWh/kg is typical for ENplus A1 pellets; your delivery note may say more. Used for the energy sensor and the price per kWh.
data_description.max_step_kg: Bigger jumps between two sensor values are ignored, e.g. after a restart or a measuring error. 10 kg works for most boilers.

source_energy_counter.title: Consumption from an energy sensor
source_energy_counter.description: Choose a sensor that counts energy in kWh. Pellets are calculated as energy divided by calorific value.

data_description.source_entity: A kWh counter of your boiler or heat meter.
data_description.calorific_value: Energy in one kg of pellets. 4.8 kWh/kg is typical for ENplus A1 pellets; your delivery note may say more. Used for the energy sensor and the price per kWh.
data_description.max_step_kg: Bigger jumps between two sensor values are ignored, e.g. after a restart or a measuring error. 10 kg works for most boilers.
data_description.efficiency: Leave at 100 % if the sensor counts the energy in the pellets (like most boilers). If it measures the heat delivered, enter the boiler efficiency, e.g. 90 %.

source_runtime.title: Consumption from burner runtime
source_runtime.description: Choose what shows that the burner runs: an on/off entity, or a sensor counting operating hours. Pellets are runtime times kg per hour.

data_description.source_entity: On/off entity (on = burner runs) or an hours counter.
data_description.calorific_value: Energy in one kg of pellets. 4.8 kWh/kg is typical for ENplus A1 pellets; your delivery note may say more. Used for the energy sensor and the price per kWh.
data_description.max_step_kg: Bigger jumps between two sensor values are ignored, e.g. after a restart or a measuring error. 10 kg works for most boilers.
data_description.kg_per_hour: How many kg the burner uses per hour at its usual power. Find it in the boiler manual (nominal fuel use) or work it out from one delivery.

storage.title: Your storage
storage.description: Tell the assistant how big the storage is and when you want a warning.

data_description.capacity_kg: How many kg fit into the storage when it is full.
data_description.min_stock_percent: Below this share of the capacity you get a warning and the 'Minimum stock reached' sensor turns on. 10 % leaves time to order.
data_description.level_entity: A sensor that measures what is really in the storage (scale, ultrasonic, radar; kg or %). It is only compared with the calculated stock; you take it over with a button. Leave empty if you have none.

start.title: Starting point
start.description: What is in the storage today? From now on, consumption is subtracted automatically and deliveries are added.

data_description.initial_stock_kg: Your best estimate. If you chose a fill level sensor, its value is suggested. You can correct it later.
data_description.initial_price_per_tonne: What you paid for these pellets, including delivery. Used for costs and price per kWh. 0 = unknown.

abort.already_configured: A storage with this name already exists.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Stock, deliveries and history are kept when you change settings.

level_unavailable.message: The fill level sensor has no valid value right now.

unknown_storage.message: This pellet storage does not exist.

storage_not_loaded.message: This pellet storage is not loaded right now.

unknown_delivery.message: No delivery with this ID. You find the IDs in the attributes of the "Last delivery" sensor.

add_delivery.name: Add delivery
add_delivery.description: Adds a pellet delivery to the stock and updates the average price.

config_entry_id.name: Storage
config_entry_id.description: The pellet storage that was filled.

kg.name: Amount
kg.description: Delivered pellets in kg (see delivery note).

price.name: Total price
price.description: What the whole delivery cost, including delivery fee. 0 if unknown.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional, e.g. supplier or quality. Not included in diagnostics.

correct_stock.name: Correct stock
correct_stock.description: Sets the stock to a known value, e.g. after looking into the storage. Consumption tracking continues from there.

stock_kg.name: Stock
stock_kg.description: What is really in the storage now, in kg.

delete_delivery.name: Delete delivery
delete_delivery.description: Removes a wrongly entered delivery and takes its amount and value back out of the stock.

config_entry_id.name: Storage
config_entry_id.description: The pellet storage of the delivery.

delivery_id.name: Delivery ID
delivery_id.description: ID from the attributes of the "Last delivery" sensor.
